Let \(y=\lg \log_3 10\). Since \(\log_3 10=\frac1{\lg 3}\), we get
\[
y=\lg\left(\frac1{\lg 3}\right)=-\lg(\lg 3).
\]
Let \(z=\lg(\lg 3)\), so \(y=-z\).

The nonconstant part
\[
g(x)=a\sin x-b\sqrt[3]{x}+c\ln(x+\sqrt{x^2+1})
\]
is odd: \(g(-x)=-g(x)\).

Given \(f(y)=5\), we have
\[
g(y)+4=5 \implies g(y)=1.
\]
Thus
\[
f(z)=g(z)+4=g(-y)+4=-g(y)+4=-1+4=3.
\]
\[
\boxed{3}
\]
